documents.route: Elector Georg Ludwig (Hannover) to J. H. von Ilten at Berlin

plaintext.source: contemporary decipherment in the recipient's office

transcription.source: GWLB Kitodo master images (public domain), read in crops
transcription.notes: Code B used for German; glosses in Kurrent read at word level. Kalliope names the sender Georg Wilhelm; the letter is signed Georg Ludwig.

system.summary: Two numeric syllabic nomenclators: code A (groups up to about 505, 1697) and code B (groups up to 1010, 1705-06, used for French and German), with homophones and nulls (62 in A, 91 in B).
system.notes: Groups separated by dots; code runs embedded in clear text. No key for A or B is known; values come from the interlinear glosses.

prior_solution.where: Interlinear decipherments on the letters themselves (GWLB); Kalliope notes 'Dechiffrierter Brief' on each record.

conditions.human_role: Project-level: set up Claude Code with Opus 5.5 and posed the problem with /goal, pasting the catalogue entry. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Kalliope SRU search 'Ilten dechiffriert': six items; the record notes read 'Dechiffrierter Brief' (deciphered), not 'not deciphered' as the catalogue had it.
Found Parts IV and VII of the Receuil de Lettres a J. H. d'Ilten in the GWLB Kitodo library (POST search), mapped folios to physical images through the METS files, fetched the 17 leaves.
Transcribed the four letters: clear text, 492 code groups and the interlinear glosses, from crops of the master images.

Built a table of every group with every gloss it carries (tables.py): no contradictions; code A and code B told apart; 62 (A) and 91 (B) identified as nulls; code B shared by the French and German letters.
Read the four letters from the glosses: Kolbe and Barfus (1697), the Prussian marriage of Sophia Dorothea (1705-06). 7 groups left unglossed by the interliner.

outcome.method_basis: Every code run carries a contemporary interlinear decipherment; the work transcribed it and checked it against the recurrence of each group.
outcome.fraction_read_source: ciphertext_A-D.txt: 492 code groups; 7 unglossed (B 419; C 709, 276, 78?, 626, 728, 36?) counted unread; 91 in C counted read as a null

gaps.item: groups running into the binding at the right margin (glosses legible)

outcome.notes: Catalogue premise corrected: Kalliope's 'Dechiffrierter Brief' means deciphered. No key for codes A or B.
